name: io.github.axute/worklog-mcp
title: Worklog
description: Work log for AI agents: record, search and report finished work, with web view and timesheet.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Named volume that keeps the database between sessions

environmentVariables.name: WORKLOG_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: Your user name; all entries belong to this user

environmentVariables.name: WORKLOG_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Agent name stored with every entry, e.g. claude-desktop

environmentVariables.name: TZ
environmentVariables.description: Time zone for dates, e.g. Europe/Berlin
